interactions.name: pricing-rules-drawers
steps: New rule: open=true text=New pricing rule A rule is never edited. This adds a new row for the channel; once approved by a second person it is in force from its date (the newest approved rule on or before the pricing day wins). Channel * B2C tailor-made Fixed departure B2B Target margin * % Gross margin on the selling price.

New FX rate: open=true text=New FX rate Rates are dated and never edited. Supplier costs convert to USD at the plain rate; a quote sold in this currency adds the buffer. A second person approves the row before any quote uses it. Currency * ISO code, e.g. EUR, GBP, VND. Units per 1 USD * EUR 0.92 · VND 25400 Selling buffer % AD
interactions.text_excerpt: Pricing rules & FX Margin policy per channel and dated FX rates against USD. Append-only: a change is a new row, and a second person approves it before it prices anything. New FX rate New rule Maker-checker. Every new rule or FX rate starts as Pending approval and is not used until another staff member approves it. The person who entered a row cannot approve it.
